name: Al Aasha Street
description: Riyadh, 1970. Aziza reminisces about her youth as she, her sister Awatif, and the fierce Bedouin Wadha navigate battles of love, ambition, and defiance in a drastically shifting society.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The family is overjoyed when Abu Ibrahim buys a colour TV, as sparks fly between Awatif and Saad. Later, a mysterious woman bearing a secret arrives in the Al A’sha neighbourhood.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Wadha strives to prove herself at the women's bazaar. Meanwhile, Aziza decides to help Awatif find a way to meet Saad.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A misunderstanding sparks a commotion on Al A’sha Street. Wadha tries to carve a place for herself among the neighbours. Meanwhile, an encounter changes Saad’s perspective on life.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As preparations for a special wedding get underway, Wadha faces a dilemma with one of the neighbours. Later, she confides in Abu Ibrahim about wanting to move to a new place.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Wadha and her children settle into their new home. Elsewhere, Saad tells his mother his desire to get married.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Awatif succumbs to despair after her family stops her from marrying Saad, as the latter decides to go away for a few days. Later, a robbery stirs panic among the residents.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Awatif is heartbroken when she discovers that Saad is marrying her best friend. Meanwhile, an emotional crisis changes Aziza’s views on love.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Aziza’s heart aches seeing Al Jazi suffering at the hands of her husband. Meanwhile, Saad sinks deeper into trouble as he’s taken to a secret training camp blindfolded.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Ibrahim takes his daughter to the doctor after she complains that she has difficulty seeing. Meanwhile, Dari grows suspicious of the girl his mother’s welcomed into their home.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: As Saad makes his way home from the secret combat training camp, Aziza tells her parents her desire to study medicine. Al Jazi receives unsettling news.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Al Jazi faces serious complications during labour amid Saad’s absence. Dari becomes enraged when he discovers that his sister is involved with a man from Al A’sha. Meanwhile, love finds its way into Atwa's heart.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Mizna takes a desperate step after her family stops her from marrying the man she loves. Meanwhile, the extremist group tasks Saad with a mission.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Tension grips Abu Ibrahim’s family following a heated clash between Rashed and Awatif in public. Meanwhile, not wanting to let go of her lover, Mizna takes matters into her own hands.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Mizna lands in trouble when the group catches her and her lover in the dead of night, as Wadha scrambles to defuse the situation. Elsewhere, Rashed decides to patch things up with Abu Ibrahim and Awatif.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Joyful cheers echo through Abu Ibrahim’s home as the family celebrates Aziza’s exam results. Elsewhere, an unexpected visitor arrives at Mizna’s.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Abu Ibrahim demands an explanation from Aziza when he runs into her at the hospital. Elsewhere, Dari’s life hangs in the balance when a masked figure sets his shop on fire.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: With his shop reduced to ashes, love becomes Dari’s only solace. Elsewhere, Abu Ibrahim delivers a stern warning to his daughter.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: After sharing her concerns about his mother with him, Aziza suggests that she and Ahmed elope. Meanwhile, Muteb suppresses his love for Atwa out of loyalty to Dari.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Aziza makes a fateful decision. Meanwhile, Atwa decides to wait for Umm Jazaa to recover before giving an answer to Dari’s proposal. A troubling issue weighs heavily on Abu Ibrahim.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: As newlywed Aziza steps into a new beginning, Saad and his group get ready to go on a risky mission.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Following the attack, the extremists spread out on Al A’sha Street, tightening their grip on the residents. Elsewhere, Aziza fulfils her dream of getting into college.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: After Abu Ibrahim sneaks into the house with a woman, his family starts digging for answers. Meanwhile, Awatif turns to her parents for protection from her husband.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: The police show up at Abu Ibrahim’s door looking for suspects. Elsewhere, Dari hits rock bottom after losing his love.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: A worried Awatif decides to check on her recluse father, as the latter admonishes Rashed for abusing his wife.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Aziza takes a risk when she ventures into the room where her father’s been hiding a man. Having had enough of her husband’s violence, Awatif decides to take matters into her own hands.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Abu Ibrahim decides to bury the hatchet with Abu Fahd. Umm Dari asks her son about his involvement with Atwa.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Atwa’s family worries when she suffers a health setback. Elsewhere, Muteb and his mother inspect the shop after it was vandalised, as Abu Ibrahim’s secret reaches the police.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Abu Ibrahim loses his temper when he catches Aziza near the storeroom. Umm Muteb gets into trouble with the merchants. Elsewhere, Al Jazi tries to persuade Abu Fahd to drop the case against Muteb.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Amid the fire devastation, Aziza tries to process her loss. Abu Fahd decides to propose to Al Jazi. Meanwhile, the police keep a close watch on Muteb.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Aziza gets a chance to meet Mansour in private. Muteb decides to confess his love to Awatif, as Rashed’s father sets out to reveal what Abu Ibrahim’s hiding to the police.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Following the devastating events that rocked Al A’sha, Aziza finds herself facing the aftermath of a heartbreaking loss, as Awatif fights for her life on the operating table.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As distant memories make their way to a barely conscious Awatif, reminding her of who she once loved, Abu Ibrahim’s family experiences their first moment of relief in a while.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Haunted by recurring nightmares of the tragic night that stole someone he loved, Khaled wakes up vowing revenge. Aziza asks her father for permission to resume studying as Awatif’s condition begins to improve.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Aziza pleads with her mother to persuade her father not to marry her off and send her to Jeddah. Meanwhile, a grieving Wadha goes door-to-door, begging for her son’s pardon and release.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Aziza is given one last chance to rethink her decision. Rashed’s father pays Dari a late-night visit with a tempting offer in exchange for writing off Muteb's debt.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: On their first day under one roof, Khaled fails to control his anger, taking it out on Aziza. As trouble piles on, Wadha is forced to take desperate measures to pay off her children’s debt.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Abu Ibrahim’s curiosity lands him in grave trouble, shaking Al A’sha to its core. Meanwhile, an emotionally-drained Aziza lives each day under the weight of Khaled’s constant suspicion.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: When they become the talk of the town, Abu Ibrahim is forced to take a desperate step, enraging his wife. Khaled’s revenge instinct awakens when he discovers that his worst enemy is still alive.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: On top of everything they’re dealing with, Abu Ibrahim fuels further rage when he makes a request of Wadha. Elsewhere, Umm Saad loses her mind and asks Aziza to take her to Saad, piquing Khaled’s interest.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: When he sees Aziza talking to Saad, Khaled is determined to question her. Elsewhere, a group of women visits Wadha and Umm Ibrahim harbouring ill will.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Khaled lands in trouble and is knocked unconscious as Aziza cries for help—only for aid to come from the very one who set everything in motion. Meanwhile, Abu Ibrahim faces a new burden.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Tension at the hospital turns into a battle with the past as the police arrive to question Khaled. With his emotions guiding him, Saad makes his way to the family home without letting anyone know.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: As Abu Ibrahim deals with an emergency involving Abu Jadaan, Umm Khaled urges her son to treat Aziza with care and to quell his violent tendencies. Saad, meanwhile, gets a chance at redemption.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Khaled gives Aziza an ultimatum: accept her fate or return to her old life with no chance of coming back. Meanwhile, Wadha makes repeated attempts to apologise to Umm Ibrahim—will forgiveness finally be granted?

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Khaled and Aziza grow closer, yet an unseen distance lingers between them. While Umm Ibrahim yearns to return home, Muteb endures a life-altering trial.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: True to his word, Abu Ibrahim puts his trust in Wadha and accepts her as one of his own. Aziza writes Saad a letter and entrusts his mother with it.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Hoping to win her heart again, Saad makes his way to the rooftop where he and Awatif shared many memories. Khaled finds himself torn between moving on with Aziza and pursuing revenge.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Awatif rides an emotional rollercoaster as she stands in front of the person who stole her heart. Elsewhere, a jealous Aziza confronts Khaled—who refuses to move on.
